text:
nina: Dropped a new frame for the trace header. Need quick callout: where do we put the correlation/permalink and how should the export CTA behave on mobile? https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/trace-header-v3

jon: My vote: compact breadcrumb under the title. Keeps header centered and wraps nicely on narrow screens.

alex: Agree. Also: make the corr-id copyable via a dedicated icon, not click-to-copy on the whole row.

maria: Accessibility: icon buttons need aria-labels + 44px hit target on mobile. Tooltips must be keyboard accessible.

nina: Microcopy: primary action = `Download trace` (JSON by default). Dropdown chevron for formats (CSV, flattened CSV, HAR).

jon: For very large traces (>10k spans / >50MB) return async job and email link. UX should show a modal explaining that.

alex: When async starts, show a toast with a "view export progress" link that opens a small modal. Screen readers: role=status for updates.

maria: Keyboard: dropdown arrow-navigable, Esc to close, focus moves to status region when export starts so SRs announce it.

nina: Visual: show short hash (0a3f...9c2) and copy icon with aria-label="Copy correlation ID <full-hash>". Clicking hash (not icon) navigates to request explorer.

access-bot: Accessibility scan: flagged low-contrast icon on dark header and small hit area on chevron. Report: /reports/1987654321

alex: I'll prototype the dropdown + async status modal and add a feature flag.

jon: I'll polish copy for modal and toast: "Preparing your trace export. We'll email when ready. View export progress."

nina: Thanks — updating Figma now and will tag for final review in ~45m.
